entries.title: Every Mac you add can control Firstmate and run work
entries.body: A Mac you add with a link at its first launch can now also run a project's work. A Mac you add by a command or by its address can open Firstmate there and control this one, with no new link. Running as another user on this Mac still only runs work. A Mac you added before keeps what it could do until you add it again, and no Mac runs anything until you set a project to run on it.
